latest_release.name: v2.1.0
latest_release.body:
<!-- release-links -->
## [⬇ Download for Windows](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/releases/download/v2.1.0/HookshotBuilder.exe)
## [⬇ Download for Linux / Steam Deck](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/releases/download/v2.1.0/Hookshot-v2.1.0-x86_64.AppImage)

---

## What's Changed
* Prevent Castle Town guard-house crashes with a larger render-target pool by @nathanaelries in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1202
* build: refuse a back end that would not load, and name the symbol by @notquiteog in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1200
* fix: preserve NUP member names during implicit reads by @klimovich008 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1185
* Document AMD courtyard shadow and sky-block workaround by @nathanaelries in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1225
* Document how to start a new game with the keyboard by @bronze-ff in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1222
* fix(builder): stop when generated source cleanup fails by @monsterlag in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1218
* perf(fpx): keep the hardware result for FMUL/FMLA S when the flags are already set by @klimovich008 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/917
* Motion controls: gyro aiming from SDL pads, with sensitivity and inverts by @wyatt-poole in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1114
* Mix for 5.1 when the default output has 5.1 speakers by @janvitos in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1182
* vk: read a pipeline cache over 2 GB on Windows by @jarynclouatre in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1226
* Run a waited-for pipeline build at once when it is still queued by @duck-paradise in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1129
* fix(vk): no mirror is made inside a parallel replay's segment by @t0masz407 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1184
* Preserve descriptor-array indices across compatible handle Phis by @klimovich008 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1038
* fix(vulkan): preserve guest mip levels in partial clears by @Trycky64 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1084
* Contain pipeline cache save allocation failures by @monsterlag in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1046
* Report finished audio buffers at the renderer update, so a speaker no longer goes silent by @janvitos in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1181
* fix(vulkan): release modules from rejected cache records by @Trycky64 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1082
* fix(vk): Linux/Wayland: take an sRGB surface format for the swapchain (#679 rebased) by @metroid98 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1086
* Builder: the ready page names both places when the build files are in a folder the player chose (rest of #623) by @amaralthalesalves in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1079
* NVIDIA DLSS, DLAA and Reflex (NGX + Vulkan, Linux and Windows, opt-in) by @hckrman101 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/841
* Show the middle 16:9 in the save picture on ultrawide by @janvitos in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1183
* perf(lift): one page mark per straight-line group of stores through a base register by @klimovich008 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/912
* fix(vk): Sharpness samples one picture pixel apart, RCAS-style, the same at any window size by @hckrman101 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1256
* perf(vk): prepare the seed's compute programs first by @hckrman101 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1277
* HD rumble on Switch Pro Controllers and Joy-Cons, through SDL's effect call by @hckrman101 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1213
* perf: stream sampled profiles instead of loading every line by @JooaoPedro15 in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1094
* vk: inline the global-load helper in task and mesh stages (the floating trees, #994) by @blushOFF in https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/1334
* Add a controller-accessible Quit option to the Gameplay menu by @
